title: Opening the project manager on Godot 32 bits makes the 64 bits counterpart crash on startup
body:
### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.6 stable, 4.7 stable, 4.8 dev 2 (and probably in all the previous versions) ### System information Godot v4.8.dev2 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Intel(R) Arc(TM) B580 Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.8864) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.91 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description After open Godot project manager using a `x86_32` binary, all my `x86_64` binaries started to crash on the project manager startup. The 32 bits version recognize the shader cache is not compatible and recompile them, but the 64 bits counterpart seems to not do the same and attempts to use the 32 bits cache and crash in the process. Deleting the `%appdata%/Roaming/Godot/shader_cache` directory fixes the issue.
